definitions.gloss: to be extremely busy; to be overwhelmed with work
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of being so busy that one has barely any free time. A formal expression emphasizing the extreme degree of busyness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多忙|たぼう}を{極|きわ}めた。
examples.english: The year-end period was extremely busy.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧、⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多忙|たぼう}を{極|きわ}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A new project started, and the entire department is extremely busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}→海外出張：24173_kaigaishucchou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多忙|たぼう}を{極|きわ}め、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まったく⟦{取|と}れなかった→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: The president was overwhelmed with overseas business trips and domestic meetings, unable to find any time for family.

notes:
A formal expression for being extremely busy. ⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ means "to reach an extreme" or "to exhaust," so the expression literally means "to reach the extreme of busyness."

THE ～を{極|きわ}める PATTERN:
This pattern means "to reach the extreme of" and appears in several set expressions:
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to live in extreme luxury
- ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to be in utter chaos
- ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to be extremely difficult
- ⟦{繁栄|はんえい}→繁栄：10131_hanei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to prosper greatly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧: busy — everyday adjective
- ⟦てんてこ{舞|ま}い→てんてこ舞い：29385_tentekomai⟧: being in a frantic rush — more colloquial and vivid
- ⟦{目|め}が{回|まわ}る→目が回る：19927_megamawaru⟧{忙|いそが}しさ: dizzyingly busy — colloquial
- {超多忙|ちょうたぼう}: super busy — more casual modern expression
